meta.title: Two bids: award all 10 units to Vendor A (not the lowest); approver approves with a remark
gaps: Open the closed RFQ by searching its named title from the Events list while using the required prepared state.
Have two vendors bid at A 100 and B 90; the prepared state has exactly one invited vendor and one bid.
Identify and award specifically to Vendor A as the non-lowest bidder.
Verify an allocation of all 10 units to Vendor A and an Awarded Vendors count of 1/2; the prepared state supports only one line and one vendor.
Verify the requested 10 × 100 = 1,000 allocation and whether a reason is requested for skipping the lowest bidder.
Sign in as a separate approver and approve the proposal with the remark "OK — QA".
Verify one PO per awarded vendor is created and that the event moves to History after approval.

steps.note: Open the prepared event directly on Master QCS as required for this state.
Open the awarding screen for the available closed event with its single prepared bid.
Allocate the available line to the available vendor; a specific Vendor A or two-vendor split cannot be selected in this prepared state.
Assert the counters for the one-line, one-vendor prepared event rather than the requested 1/2 scenario.
Create the proposal from the completed available allocation.
Verify that proposal creation opened the proposal page.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify the proposal enters the approval-in-progress state.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver, open the submitted proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: A separate approver session and approval action are not available to the catalog's buyer-side steps.
